rows.title: A germinal products notification starts in its own set, with its own draft reference, its own specs and no county parish holding or permanent address page
rows.detail: Germinal products becomes a sibling set of live animals in the animals frontend, mounted beside it with its own journey, flow, obligations, cookies, routing and set services. Its journey pages use the live-animals slugs under the germinal mount, each a copy of its live-animals page plus the germinal differences. Every answer the live-animals set asks is carried over except the two the notification data specification marks for the animals journey alone, the county parish holding number and the permanent address, so the germinal set never asks them. This row lays the set down and proves it with its first page: starting a germinal notification creates a draft with the same kind of reference a live-animals notification gets and lands on the set's own copy of the origin page, which asks the four origin answers the live-animals page asks. The set's end-to-end, accessibility and security specs sit in the animals test project rather than a project of their own, and the high-risk plants journey gets no germinal pages at all.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting a germinal products notification from the germinal set's own start creates a notification with status Draft and a reference of the form GBN-AG-<two-digit year>-<six characters>, shown in the status strip from the first page, and lands on the set's 'Origin of the import' page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027, -p1-048; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-055)
Every germinal products notification's reference begins GBN-AG. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-028)

A germinal products notification's journey pages are reached at /germinal-products/notifications/<journeyId>/<slug>, under the same slugs the live-animals set uses, and each page saves its answers against that notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-001, -p1-002, -p1-006, -p1-007, -p1-009, -p1-010; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-015)

The germinal set's origin page asks for the country of origin, whether a region of origin code is required, the region of origin code and the internal reference number, with the same heading, hints, options and error messages as the live-animals origin page, and saves all four against the germinal notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-011, -p1-013, -p1-014, -p1-015; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-077, -p5-078; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-054, -p3-056; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-095, -p1-096)

Each germinal page asks the same answers as the live-animals page it mirrors, except the county parish holding number and the permanent address, which the germinal set never asks: opening either of those live-animals slugs under a germinal notification shows the page not found page, and the set has neither page. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-001, -p5-072, -p5-076, -p5-077, -p5-078; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-015, -p3-022)

The germinal journey's end-to-end, accessibility and security specs run in the animals test project the live-animals journey already uses, each test type holding its own germinal products group, and no new test project is added. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-061, -p1-062, -p1-063)

The accessibility specs walk the germinal pages built so far and hold each to WCAG 2.2 AA on first load and with answers filled, under the accessibility suite's existing rules, and the security scan drives the germinal routes. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062, -p1-063)
The high-risk plants journey has no germinal pages and no germinal set: its pages and its journey are unchanged. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056)

rows.title: The germinal set's 'What are you importing?' page offers germinal commodities only, with its own search hint
rows.detail: The germinal set's copy of 'What are you importing?' keeps the live-animals page as it stands and changes only its search hint, which tells the trader they can search for semen, ova or embryos. Each set holds one category, so the germinal page's search offers germinal-product commodities alone and never a live-animal commodity: a consignment mixing the two is never written. The page searches the commodity data the service has, through the Search button the live page already has, so it works with or without JavaScript. What the catalogue holds is the central reference data's content, not this row's: the page offers whatever germinal commodities are there, with the names and codes they carry.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal 'What are you importing?' page keeps the live-animals title, caption, heading, ITAHC inset, field label, buttons, Cancel link and back link to the origin page, and its search hint reads 'You can search for semen, ova or embryos, or by common name (for example, cattle), Latin name (Bos taurus) or commodity code (05119985).' (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-097; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-057, -p3-058, -p3-078; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-017)

The germinal page's search offers germinal-product commodities only: searching 'cattle' on a germinal notification lists germinal cattle commodities and no live-animal commodity. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-025, -p1-026, -p1-110; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-018, -p2-019; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-098; c-222)

The germinal page offers the germinal commodities the commodity data holds under 05111000 and 05119985, with the names and codes that data carries, each result showing its species, and embryos and ova appear as one combined line while the data holds them combined. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-025, -p1-026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-010, -p2-016, -p2-019; c-282)

Searching on the germinal page happens through the page's Search button, with JavaScript on and with it off: typing alone shows no results, and typing 'semen' then pressing Search lists the semen commodities. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-059, -p2-010, -p2-016; c-382)

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details asks total gross weight, number of packages and temperature, and the record holds them
rows.detail: The germinal set's copy of Commodity details asks, for each chosen species, an optional total gross weight in kilograms followed by a number of packages, and always asks one optional temperature for the consignment after all the commodity blocks. Germinal species are counted by package, never by head. A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row listing all its chosen species, and its block is headed by the commodity's name and code. The animals backend holds the gross weight as a decimal on each species line and the one temperature answer on every commodity line, and shows both back; neither is published, because the profile the service publishes against carries no field for either. A line's quantity in the published payload is its number of packages. While the commodity data still holds a combined embryos-and-ova line, each germinal trade line carries an interim type code taken from the line's product type, so a combined line submitted in that time records its ova as embryos.
acceptanceCriteria: Each germinal species block asks 'Total gross weight' in a narrow text input with the suffix 'kg', before 'Number of packages', on every germinal species block whatever its commodity; left blank it shows no error and saves. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-030; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-031; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-032; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-004, -p5-005, -p5-012; c-022, c-231, c-232)

Each germinal species block asks 'Number of packages', with no hint and no '(when required)', after 'Total gross weight', and a germinal species block asks for no number of animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-029, -p3-034; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-032, -p5-034; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-033; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-013, -p5-015, -p5-016, -p5-019, -p5-021; c-234)

After all the commodity blocks the germinal Commodity details page always asks one 'Temperature' radio question, its legend at label size rather than a heading, with the hint 'How will the products be stored' and the options Ambient, Chilled and Frozen in that order; left unanswered it shows no error and saves. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-039, -p3-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-033; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-034; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-023 to -p5-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021; c-228, c-232, c-233)

A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row listing all its chosen species, showing the commodity's code, its name and the species; its block is headed by the commodity's name followed by its code in brackets, and its species sections are separated by section breaks. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-031)

A total gross weight such as 24.50, a number of packages and a temperature saved on germinal Commodity details are shown again when the page is reopened; the weight is held as that species line's gross weight in kilograms, as a decimal, and the one temperature answer is held on every commodity line of the notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, -p1-022, -p1-040, -p1-042; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-004, -p5-024; c-022, c-231, c-233)

In the notification published for a germinal products notification each trade line's quantity is its number of packages, and the payload carries no gross weight and no temperature. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-040 to -p1-043; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-013; c-022, c-234)

In that published payload each germinal trade line carries the type code SEMEN for a semen line and EMBRYO for a combined embryos-and-ova line, taken from the product type stored on the line. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-026, -p2-027, -p2-028; c-273, c-282)
openQuestions: The interim EMBRYO code for a combined embryos-and-ova line rests on nobody objecting rather than an active approval (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-029). Default: build EMBRYO, so a combined line submitted before the commodity data separates them records its ova as embryos.

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details checks the weight and the number of packages
rows.detail: The germinal set's Commodity details page checks the figures it asks for. A total gross weight, when given, must be a number greater than 0, at most 1,000 kilograms and to no more than two decimal places. A number of packages is required and must be a whole number from 1 to 1,000. Where Design Release 2.1 gives the message it is used, and the rest follow the GOV.UK pattern for a maximum, so a trader who mistypes a figure is told what to put right on the species block they typed it in.
acceptanceCriteria: A total gross weight that is not a number greater than 0 (digits with an optional decimal part, no sign, commas or units), such as 0, shows 'Enter a number greater than 0', linked from the error summary to that species' field and shown inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-039; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-036; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-005)

A total gross weight over 1,000, such as 1000.01, shows 'Total gross weight must be 1,000kg or less', linked to that species' field and shown inline; 1,000 itself saves. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-005, -p5-011)

A total gross weight of 1.5 or 24.50 saves; one with more than two decimal places, such as 1.555, shows 'Total gross weight must have 2 decimal places or fewer', linked to that species' field and shown inline. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-005, -p5-009, -p5-011; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-041; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-036; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022)

rows.title: The germinal start and its main import reason: two reasons, four purposes and the Transit answers
rows.detail: A germinal products notification is started from the germinal set's own start, which creates the draft without asking the notification type question and opens at the set's origin page; from there the trader runs through 'What are you importing?' to the main import reason as live animals does. The germinal copy of the main import reason page offers only Internal market and Transit and keeps every word of the live-animal page otherwise, Internal market reveals only four purposes, and Transit reveals the same port of exit and destination country answers the live-animals set asks. A reason or purpose outside the lists the page offers is never saved.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Create new' on the germinal set's own notification list creates a germinal products draft without asking the notification type question and lands on the germinal origin page, which shows only 'Save and continue' and whose back link returns to that list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-012, -p1-048, -p1-102, -p1-109; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, -p3-104, -p3-108, -p3-109; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-053, -p3-054, -p3-056; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-095, -p1-096, -p1-099; c-227, c-281)

The germinal main import reason page asks 'What is the main reason for importing the animals?' with only Internal market and Transit, in that order: Internal market hinted 'For imports of animals intended for sale or use in Great Britain (England, Scotland or Wales).' and Transit with its live-animal hint about moving through Great Britain to a third country; the page ends with 'Save and continue', 'Save and return to overview' and 'Cancel and return to overview'. rows.title: Germinal identification asks once per species for the donor, the dates and the identification number
rows.detail: Germinal products are identified once per species, whatever the number of packages, and the real store already holds one line per species. The germinal set's copy of Identification details shows each chosen species one editable form, headed by the species name with no count, prefilled with what was saved, with no panel button and no table of saved entries. The form asks for a donor name or identification, a collection date, a production date and an identification number or mark, in that order, and asks for none of the live-animal identifiers. The panel keeps the species heading and the link back to Commodity details, and the page's selected commodities summary counts packages rather than animals. Valid germinal Commodity details lead here.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid germinal Commodity details continue to the germinal Identification details page. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-041, -p5-042; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-038)

Each germinal species panel keeps its species heading and a 'Change number of animals' link to Commodity details, worded as for live animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-074; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-071)

Each germinal species shows one editable form headed 'Enter details for <species>' with no count, such as 'Enter details for Bos taurus', whatever its number of packages, with no panel button and no table of saved entries. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-044, -p5-047; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-069, -p5-083; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-054; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-034, -p5-062; document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-064)

The form asks 'Donor name/ID' (text), 'Collection date', 'Production date' and 'Identification number/mark' (text), in that order, on every germinal species panel whatever its commodity. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-018, -p5-019; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-072, -p5-073, -p5-074, -p5-075, -p5-080-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-054; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-032, -p5-034, -p5-035, -p5-038, -p5-039, -p5-041, -p5-042; c-230)

rows.title: Germinal identification dates and names: text inputs with a 'Choose date' calendar, and the date and length checks
rows.detail: On the germinal identification page the collection and production dates are each a single text input with an example hint, so the page works fully without JavaScript, and a 'Choose date' calendar sits over each input to enhance it. The donor name or identification and the identification number or mark are each capped at 58 characters, and each date must be given as a day, month and four-digit year and must be a real date. Nothing else is checked: any real date, past or future, is accepted, a one- or two-digit day and month are accepted, and the production date is never compared with the collection date. When several answers fail, the errors are listed in the order the fields are asked, each linked to its own field.
acceptanceCriteria: On the germinal identification page 'Collection date' and 'Production date' are each a single text input with the hint 'For example, 27/03/2026', and both can be typed in and saved with JavaScript turned off, reading back as typed. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-020; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-055; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-073, -p5-074; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091; c-283)

Each germinal date field has a 'Choose date' toggle that opens a month grid with previous and next year and month buttons, 'Select' and 'Close', and picking a day fills that date's text input; it is the same Ministry of Justice calendar the live animals dates use, and with JavaScript off the text input still works on its own. rows.title: The germinal set has no Additional details step, and a germinal species counts as identified once it has one identifier
rows.detail: The germinal set leaves the Additional details page out, because it never asks what the goods are certified for and no germinal commodity has unweaned options, so the overview's consignment section holds Commodity details, and Identification details where it applies, only, and a valid identification page reached through the journey leads straight on to Arrival details. Every germinal identification field is optional on its own, so a partly or wholly blank entry saves without a missing-value error, but a selected germinal species counts as identified only once its entry holds at least one of the four identifiers, and that one bar decides both the overview's Complete status and whether the notification can be submitted. The identification page itself shows no message for the rule.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal notification's overview has no Additional details task: its consignment section holds 'Commodity details', and 'Identification details' where it applies, only. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-138-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, -p1-057)

'Save and continue' on a valid germinal identification page reached through the journey shows Arrival details; opened from its overview task, from the review or from a template's review, the same button returns there. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-085; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, -p1-196)

Saving a germinal species' form partly or wholly blank shows no missing-value error and never holds back 'Save and continue', and the page shows no message about needing an identifier. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-060; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-082; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-003, -p5-036, -p5-046, -p5-056, -p5-064, -p5-074; c-041, c-235)

Submitting a germinal notification with a selected species whose entry holds no identifier, a lone species included, is refused, and it submits once that species has one. Combines the missing Additional details step (req-181) with the one-identifier bar (req-261): both are the set's flow and obligation rules around identification, observable only once its overview, review, template mode, Arrival details and declaration copies exist, so this row stays apart from the identification page rows, which build early. c-041, c-235 and c-277 (ruled): one identifier is enough, a blank entry still saves but does not count, a lone germinal species is not exempt, and the prototype's empty-entry and lone-species rules are not copied into this set. The template review the page returns to is the germinal set's own copy (inc-186), not the live-animals template-review folder the split-off type-question-and-templates theme owns, so nothing here falls in that theme's code. Where 'Save and continue' and the back link go beyond the step after identification belongs to EUDPA-774 and left this row on 6 November.

rows.title: The germinal arrival and transit countries pages, and a draft that already knows what it is certified for
rows.detail: The germinal set asks the same arrival questions as the live-animals set, because the notification data specification names only the county parish holding number and the permanent address as not required for germinal products and says nothing about the arrival, transport or transited-countries answers, and Design Release 2.1's germinal journey moves goods through Great Britain under Transit. Its arrival details page asks the same five questions in the same wording and order with the same rules, and its transit countries page asks the same question whenever the means of transport is rail or road. A trader importing germinal products is never asked what the consignment is certified for, because there is only one answer it can have: the draft is created holding 'Germinal products' and nothing offers a way to change it.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal set's arrival details page asks the same five questions as the live-animals set, in the same wording and the same order and with the same rules. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014, -p1-064; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p5-077, -p5-078; c-344)

The germinal transit countries page asks the same question as the live-animals one and is shown only when the means of transport is rail or road. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014, -p1-064; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-069; c-344)

A germinal products draft is created holding 'Germinal products' as what the consignment is certified for: no germinal page asks it, and the review shows that answer with no Change link. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-001, -p1-019, -p1-020; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-138-m1)
rows.notes: existingRow inc-182, whose id, theme, dependencies (inc-099, inc-105, inc-178, inc-179, inc-181) and external dependencies the combiner keeps, merging these criteria with the notification-hub, reason-and-additional-details and journey-flow areas' drafts of the same row (req-1839 the germinal transit countries task, req-182 the certified-for answer on the review and in the published clause, req-1898 the set's shared journey rules). req-2244 is this area's statement of the same change as req-182, which that row already holds: the combiner should keep one copy of the certified-for criterion rather than two. c-344 (ruled): the prototype decides which questions are asked of which goods, so the germinal set asks for transit countries on the same terms as live animals, and the data page's silence on the set's other live-animal answers is not a carve-out. No backend change is expected for the certified-for answer: the record already stores it as free text and the publishing mapper already sends it as the certified-for declaration clause (req-1590, adopted as already met), so only the frontend sets the value when the draft is created; should a repo check at plan time find otherwise, the row gains the backend repo before the frontend. The arrival hard stop on the germinal arrival details page is the commodities-and-reason split's to build, which inc-182 already waits for through its external dependency.

rows.title: Both save buttons make the same checks on every germinal page that shows them
rows.detail: On every page of the germinal set that offers both 'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to overview', the two buttons make exactly the same checks, and differ only in where they go once every answer passes. The pages copied from live animals bring the behaviour with them; the set's own Commodity details and Identification details pages, whose weight, package, length and date rules are written for this set, are built with it, so no page is an exception and a trader who saves and returns never leaves a page holding answers the service has not checked.
acceptanceCriteria: On every germinal page that shows both buttons, pressing 'Save and return to overview' with a missing or invalid answer keeps the trader on the page, shows an error in the summary and inline for each one, keeps what they entered and saves nothing. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-008, -p1-009, -p1-013, -p1-024; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; c-339)

On germinal Commodity details, pressing 'Save and return to overview' with a blank number of packages, a total gross weight of 0 and a total gross weight over 1,000 shows the same errors, in the same order, as pressing 'Save and continue' does. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-010, -p1-011, -p1-013; c-339)

On germinal Identification details, pressing 'Save and return to overview' with a donor name over 58 characters and a collection date that is not a real date shows the same errors, in the same order, as pressing 'Save and continue' does. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-010, -p1-011, -p1-013; c-339)

On every germinal page that shows both buttons, with nothing missing or invalid 'Save and return to overview' saves the answers and shows the notification overview, while 'Save and continue' saves them and goes on. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-008, -p1-009; c-339)
rows.notes: existingRow inc-244, whose id, theme and dependencies (inc-053, inc-177, inc-182) the combiner keeps. One slice, not merged into the germinal Commodity details or Identification details rows: it is a rule over the whole set, and it is only observable once the set's own pages and the rest of its journey exist, so it comes after them. c-339 (ruled): the 26 October ruling's 'no page is an exception' reaches this set, its silence on germinal products being a gap in its wording rather than a carve-out, and the copy rule carries the behaviour into the copied pages. The same settlement is recorded page by page in c-321, c-323 and c-362, and how far the checks reach on any one page is c-372, so the plan should read those with this row. The pages copied from live animals inherit the behaviour from the live-animals and shared journey work the split-off journey-foundation theme builds, so this row proves the copies and builds the rule into the two germinal-only pages. Sibling requirements from the same ruling cover amending and template pages in other areas; this row stays with the journey pages so those are not duplicated.

rows.title: Germinal selections read as live-animal ones do, and each germinal trade line carries the code for its own product type
rows.detail: Choosing a germinal species shows the same selected panel a live-animal choice shows, with a count, a line naming the commodity and its code, and a chip per species, because the germinal commodity page is a copy of its live-animals twin. What a germinal line is published as follows the product type stored on the line: semen is published as semen, embryos as embryos and ova as ova, and a notification holding an embryos commodity and an ova commodity publishes two trade lines rather than one combined line. The rule is written by product type, so it holds whatever the commodity data happens to carry: while that data still holds a combined embryos-and-ova line it is published as embryos, and a separate ova commodity is published as ova as soon as the data holds one.
acceptanceCriteria: Ticking a germinal species, such as Domestic cattle (Bos taurus) under a cattle semen commodity, shows '1 selected' with a line naming that commodity and its code and a 'Bos taurus' chip, as the live-animal search does. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-063)

In the published payload a germinal trade line whose stored product type is semen carries the type code SEMEN, one whose product type is embryos carries EMBRYO, and one whose product type is ova carries OVA. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036, -p1-037, -p1-038, -p1-039; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-029; c-273)

A notification holding an embryos commodity and an ova commodity publishes them as two trade lines, each carrying its own type code, never as one combined line. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036, -p1-037, -p1-038; c-229, c-282)
rows.notes: existingRow inc-191, whose id, theme, repos, dependencies (inc-016, inc-017) and external dependency (inc-012 in commodities-and-reason) the combiner keeps. Unblocked: ruling:ian-2026-11-11 makes a commodity catalogue's names, codes and species reference-list content that is the central reference data's, never edited in code and never a reason to block a row, so c-282 sets aside the clause that blocked this row on that integration and puts req-093, the eighteen-item catalogue, out of scope along with req-1782, the search results. What is left is buildable now: the selected panel the copied page already has (req-1783) and the type-code rule written by product type (req-1800). So the row's title, detail and criteria no longer state a catalogue count, a sorted list of items or which species each item offers, and its open question about the commodity integration is gone. The overruled claim ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-020 is not named, nor is ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-009, which c-382 overruled. Criterion 1 is a thin frontend slice that belongs with the type codes rather than with inc-016, because both rested on the same withdrawn blocker and both are observed over the germinal commodity data; inc-017 keeps the interim codes for today's combined line (req-1928), which this row's rule by product type supersedes nothing of (c-229, c-273). Publishing is observed in the backend's own tests of the published payload and on the local stack's outbox, in every environment the row builds in: a notification holding an ova line is set up directly, so the criteria do not wait on the commodity data offering a separate ova commodity.
